purpose: Rules for how Lyra should adapt this visual prototype without inventing a random layout.

bestFor: businesses selling unrelated or broad product types

generationRules: Lyra may rewrite copy but must not paste raw intake notes into the page.
Lyra may adapt colors but must keep contrast accessible.
Lyra must preserve search-first marketplace structure.
Lyra must show vendor grouping in cart and checkout.
Lyra must not invent final totals, shipping guarantees, reviews, or vendor verification.
Lyra should route this template when the user describes many products, broad categories, marketplace behavior, or a store similar in scale to a large catalog.
